text:
The photo shows a square slice of lasagna, a small plate of beef noodles (lo mein style), and a glass of water. This is a before-eating image, so I can't see what is left over and have to guess.

Estimated servings:
- Lasagna: about 200 g, roughly 350 kcal, with 20 g protein, 28 g carbohydrate and 17 g fat.
- Beef noodles: about 200 g, roughly 330 kcal, with 15 g protein, 42 g carbohydrate and 11 g fat.

Together that is about 680 kcal served. I assumed roughly 10% would be left over, about 70 kcal. That leaves about 610 kcal eaten.

For the macros of what is eaten, I took 90% of the combined totals (35 g protein, 70 g carbohydrate, 28 g fat), which gives about 32 g protein, 63 g carbohydrate and 25 g fat.
